text: **Hint 1:** Consider how false positive predictions are penalized in both the loss function $\mathcal{L}$ and the cross-entropy loss. Think about the impact of these predictions on the overall cost incurred by each loss function.\n\n**Hint 2:** Recall the definition of a false positive in the context of logistic regression. Analyze how each loss function treats predictions that are false positives and compare the severity of the penalties imposed by $\mathcal{L}$ and cross-entropy loss.
